name: Catering (Casual BBQ)
tagline: A hearty, no-fuss template for BBQ & casual caterers — book tastings from day one.
description: A bold, smoky catering site for a casual BBQ & food-truck outfit — a kraft ground, a deep-rust primary and an ember-amber accent under a sturdy condensed display. Installs online booking for tastings and event consults: a real menu (free consults, BBQ and taco-bar tastings, corporate and game-day packages), three coordinators you book by name with their own hours, and a tasting-deposit policy. Ships as "Smoke & Barrel BBQ Catering".
